comments.body: [P2] Claude's credential check ignores `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, even though that variable is passed to the child CLI. When subscription credentials exist only in the configured directory, `available()` rejects the client before Claude can read them. Resolve the credentials file relative to the configured directory when present.
